The Beginning of Vijayanagara Empire - Sangama Dynasty
# The empire was founded by two brothers, Harihara and Bukka, who were captured by Muhammad bin Tughluq's forces.
# They were taken to Delhi, forcibly converted to Islam, and later sent back to the Deccan to quell a rebellion.
# A sage named Vidyaranya helped them revert to Hinduism, and they established the Sangama dynasty in 1336.
# There are two theories on their origin: one suggests they were Telugu, and the other claims they were Kannada generals under the Hoysala king.
